architecture_search.description: Single-seed RMSE of configuration variants trained for 50 epochs with a point-prediction head on the three tuning datasets (Supplementary Table S11). diverged_cells lists the run that diverged.
architecture_search.note: Single unseeded runs; each value is the lowest test-split RMSE over 50 epochs. A run intended to remove the LSTM is omitted because its option had no effect in the code version used.
